```mcstas
DEFINE INSTRUMENT tof_imaging_beamline(lam=3.5, dlam=1.3, ap_D=0.016)

TRACE

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
    xwidth = 0.1,
    yheight = 0.12,
    dist = 1.0,
    focus_xw = ap_D,
    focus_yh = ap_D,
    lambda0 = lam,
    dlambda = dlam,
    flux = 10000000000000.0
)
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT aperture = Slit(
    radius = 0.5 * ap_D
)
AT (0, 0, 1.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT scraper = Slit(
    xwidth = 0.3,
    yheight = 0.3
)
AT (0, 0, 10.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT fov_mon = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 128,
    ny = 128,
    filename = "fov.dat",
    xwidth = 0.28,
    yheight = 0.28,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT (0, 0, 20.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 256,
    ny = 256,
    filename = "det.dat",
    xwidth = 0.2,
    yheight = 0.2,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT (0, 0, 25.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det_lam = L_monitor(
    nL = 200,
    filename = "det_lam.dat",
    xwidth = 0.2,
    yheight = 0.2,
    Lmin = lam - 2 * dlam,
    Lmax = lam + 2 * dlam,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT (0, 0, 25.01) RELATIVE src

END
```
